trust_decision.summary: Both GitHub App connect-completion handlers bind a client-supplied installation_id to the caller's project after matching only a pending-connector state value, so nothing ever decides whether the caller's GitHub identity owns that installation.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary and the product docs name the connector completion call (docs/auth/github-connector.md:30-32, route registered at internal/api/router.go:2211), so the first read is CompleteGitHubConnector and its request struct at internal/api/github_connect.go:113-119.

fix_sites.module_kind: http_handler (internal/api), second (legacy project-scoped) implementation of the same completion
connector_client / lower_level_api, new package file absent at pinned commit

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The project-scoped route is documented as internal compatibility code that new UI, docs and automation must not depend on (docs/auth/github-connector.md:20), so a solver can leave CompleteGitHubConnection - and the X-GitHub-Installation-ID fallback in the neighbouring router file - alone as a legacy path the advisory is not about.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Reloading an already-connected GitHub App connector from persisted state must keep working with no OAuth code available: githubConnectionFromStored runs on every cache miss, on repo-selection updates, on webhook secret rotation, and in the worker before minting a clone token (internal/api/service.go:2271-2291). An over-broad fix that demands ownership proof wherever installation_id is used breaks all existing connectors.

O6_input_shapes: installation_id as a JSON number in the completion body
installation_id as the X-GitHub-Installation-ID header string, used only when the body value is 0 (internal/api/router.go:2225-2232 and 3654-3661; the fix deletes this fallback)
OAuth code appended to the post-install redirect and sent as the new code field
client-supplied account_login, which the fix replaces with the GitHub-verified account login
missing/empty code and installation_id <= 0, which the fix rejects

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A PAT-connector route that also accepts an installation_id to link a PAT to an existing App installation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: UpsertGitHubPATConnector writes the same connector type and status shape as the App flow into the same project, so a maintainer adding 'reuse my installation' there would set the id from the request without an OAuth proof.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An installation.created branch in the installation webhook that binds that installation to a project
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The signed webhook already carries installation.id and account.login and the neighbouring markGitHubInstallationDisconnected branch already rewrites connector metadata from it, so auto-provisioning on install looks natural there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second composition root (worker/CLI builder) that constructs api.Service without the verifier
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The verifier is injected in exactly one builder, so a sibling builder copied from it would silently fall back to the old trust unless the fail-closed nil check is remembered.

O9_family: CWE-639 cross-tenant IDOR / CWE-862 missing authorization on GitHub App installation binding

O10_build.language: Go (with a TypeScript web app in web/)
O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25.11 (go.mod:3); make test -> go test ./... (Makefile:47-48); npm ci/build for web (Makefile:53-60)
O10_build.project_tests: internal/api/github_connect_test.go and internal/api/github_connector_v2_test.go drive the router with an in-memory store and a fake GitHub repository lister; internal/connectors/github/{repositories,app,posture}_test.go use httptest servers. The fix's new OAuth tests (internal/connectors/github/oauth_test.go) are not present at the pinned commit.

j.j_sites_touched: internal/api/github_connect.go, internal/api/router.go, internal/api/service.go, internal/config/config.go, internal/connectors/github/oauth.go, internal/runtime/service_builder.go, web/src/api/client.ts, web/src/productShell.tsx
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a code field and a /user/installations ownership check only inside the newer POST /v1/connectors/github/complete handler, leaving the legacy CompleteGitHubConnection and the X-GitHub-Installation-ID fallback trusting the body value.

out_of_scope_notes: The same fix also edits terraform, helm, systemd, docker, workflow, manifest, script and docs files; these are deployment/config plumbing for the new OAuth credential, not part of the protected operation, and were not pursued.
